items.caption: A modern drawing of 口 in Shuowen seal-script style. It illustrates the received analysis of 知 as containing 口, but does not establish 口’s original role in the graph.
items.alt: Black, U-shaped seal-script drawing of 口 with a horizontal stroke across its middle, on a white background.
items.selection_reason: The image visibly shows the 口 component cited in the received analysis of 知. Its seal-script style is relevant to that account, while the redraw is not a dated inscription or proof of the graph’s early construction.

limitations.text: This is a modern seal-script redraw of 口, not a dated inscription of 知; it cannot establish the character’s early form or the historical role of 口.
